dogecoin.text:
$DOGE beats $XRP by $8.13B (market capitalization) as Dogecoin continues to soar, with an astounding 28%-31% gain in the day, up to approximately 55¢.

Dogecoin is now the fourth largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization for now. Crash or cash? We'll see!

Dogecoin priced way too much hype in. They bought in as if all Elon was going to do was joke about $DOGE all day. Poor retail investors.

I would like to remind investors to look after yourselves and watch out for bubbles. Don't get screwed! The market overprices all the time.
@oeprov @ddofinternet Standard retirement portfolio would be 33% Dogecoin 33% AMC and 33% Gamestop

$DOGE is up 4% and is breaching an important trendline
